questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The phenomenon of bending of light around obstacles is called:
questions.explanation: Diffraction is the bending of waves around the edges of an obstacle or through an aperture.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: From the given p-V diagram, identify the thermodynamic process AB represented.
questions.explanation: Process AB is a horizontal line on the p-V diagram, meaning pressure remains constant while volume changes. This is an Isobaric (constant pressure) process.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean physics p-V diagram. X-axis: Volume V. Y-axis: Pressure P. Shows a horizontal line from point A (lower volume) to point B (higher volume) at constant pressure P₀. Arrow pointing right from A to B. Label 'Process AB'. Grid lines shown. Professional thermodynamics style.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The power of a convex lens of focal length 25 cm is:
questions.explanation: P = 1/f (in meters) = 1/0.25 = +4 D. Positive for convex lens.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of σ and π bonds in ethylene (C₂H₄) is:
questions.explanation: Ethylene: H₂C=CH₂. C=C has 1σ + 1π bond. Each C-H is a σ bond (4 total). Total: 5σ + 1π.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Identify the type of crystal system shown in the unit cell diagram.
questions.explanation: A BCC unit cell has atoms at 8 corners plus one atom at the body center of the cube. Total atoms per unit cell = 8×(1/8) + 1 = 2.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean chemistry diagram of a Body Centered Cubic (BCC) unit cell. Cube with atoms (blue spheres) at all 8 corners and ONE atom at the exact center of the cube body. Corner atoms shown as partial spheres. Center atom shown as full sphere. Labels 'Corner atom' and 'Body center atom'. Dashed lines showing edges. Professional crystallography style.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Baking soda is chemically:
questions.explanation: Baking soda is Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO₃). Washing soda is Na₂CO₃·10H₂O.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The VSEPR shape of H₂O is:
questions.explanation: O in H₂O has 2 bond pairs + 2 lone pairs (sp³ hybridized). Due to lone pair repulsion, the shape is Bent/V-shaped with bond angle ~104.5°.

questions.question: From the pie chart, what percentage of students prefer Mathematics?
questions.explanation: The Mathematics sector occupies 108° out of 360°. Percentage = (108/360) × 100 = 30%.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which blood vessel carries deoxygenated blood from the body to the heart?
questions.explanation: Vena cava (superior and inferior) carries deoxygenated blood from the body to the right atrium of the heart.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Identify the labeled structure 'Y' in the cross-section of a leaf.
questions.explanation: The columnar, tightly packed cells just below the upper epidermis rich in chloroplasts are the Palisade mesophyll cells, the primary site of photosynthesis.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology cross-section diagram of a Dicot leaf. Shows layers from top: Upper Epidermis, Palisade Mesophyll (labeled 'Y' with arrow, columnar cells with chloroplasts), Spongy Mesophyll (loosely arranged with air spaces), Lower Epidermis with Stomata (guard cells). Vascular bundle (xylem and phloem) in the center. Professional plant anatomy style.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes Night Blindness?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A (retinol) deficiency causes Night Blindness (Nyctalopia). Vitamin A is essential for the formation of rhodopsin in rod cells of the retina.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The exchange of gases in the lungs takes place in:
questions.explanation: Alveoli are tiny air sacs in the lungs with thin walls and rich blood supply where O₂ and CO₂ exchange occurs by diffusion.
